auftrag: Read the timetable, the announcement and the diary. Then solve five puzzles.

saetze: 09:42 – platform 4 – arrives 10:58 – stops at Gatwick Airport
The nine forty-two to Brighton now leaves from platform 6.
The train is ten minutes late.
Please mind the gap, and keep your bags with you.
We came to the station at half past nine and bought two tickets.
We ran to platform 6 and jumped on the train just before the doors closed.
Pidge sat on my bag all the way.

raetsel.frage: Which train stops at Gatwick Airport?
raetsel.hilfe2: They are in the second line of the timetable.

raetsel.frage: How long is the journey if the train is on time?
raetsel.hilfe1: The train leaves at 09:42 and arrives at 10:58.
raetsel.hilfe2: From 09:42 to 10:42 is one hour. Then count the rest.

raetsel.frage: True or false? “There is a restaurant car on the train.”
raetsel.hilfe1: Look for the word "restaurant" in the texts.
raetsel.hilfe2: You cannot find it. The text says nothing about it.
raetsel.rtyp: True, false or not in the text

raetsel.frage: Put the events in the right order. What happened first?
raetsel.hilfe1: Read the diary from top to bottom.
raetsel.hilfe2: The announcement comes after the waiting and before the running.

raetsel.frage: Agent Wren wrote a short note on the train. It has four mistakes. Can you find them?
raetsel.text: We [[goes|go|going]] to Brighton by train. The train [[leave|leaves|leaving]] at nine forty-two, but it is [[tenn|ten|tan]] minutes late. Pidge [[sit|sits|sitting]] on my bag.
raetsel.hilfe1: Look at the verbs and at the spelling of the number.
raetsel.hilfe2: "The train" and "Pidge" are one thing each. They need an -s.
